description:
A private ntfy push-notification server per enrollment: publish over plain HTTP, receive on iOS, Android, desktop or a streaming client.

UnitySVC runs the official ntfy image in an isolated container for each enrollment, reachable at its own HTTPS address. Every request must carry your access token. Message priorities, tags, click actions, scheduled delivery and attachments all work as in ntfy. Messages are capped at 4096 bytes and kept for 12 hours. Storage is temporary: cached messages are lost when the instance is replaced or stopped. Billing is per instance-month.

Enroll in the base channel, keep or replace the generated access token, then publish with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to `https://<instance>/<topic>`. Point the ntfy app at the same instance URL to subscribe. See How to use this service for the full setup and limitations.

features: A private instance for each enrollment, protected by your access token

name: ntfy-sh
summary: Push notifications over plain HTTP: POST a message from any script, CI pipeline, or app and receive it on your phone, desktop, or a streaming client, on your own private ntfy instance.

base.description: One private ntfy instance for one enrollment; temporary storage.

NTFY_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Generated for this enrollment; keep it or enter your own (the form tk_ followed by 29 letters, digits, - or _). It is the Bearer token for publishing to and subscribing from your instance, and without it every request is denied. Save it; it is also shown in the enrollment's instance details. Changing it later restarts the instance.
NTFY_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Access token
